how.title: A conversation can make it simpler.
how.subtitle: Take it one step at a time, with room to ask the questions that matter to you.

1.title: Share your needs
1.body: Think about what you want to protect, your priorities, and the questions you would like to ask.

2.title: Discuss your options
2.body: Review available plans with an advisor. Ask about the cover, costs, and conditions before deciding.

3.title: Arrange your cover
3.body: When you find a suitable plan, discuss the application and next steps with your advisor.

faq.title: Good questions. Clearer choices.
faq.subtitle: A starting point for understanding your options.

items.a: Choose what you want to protect in the insurance types section. Then browse the insurers and open a plan to read more.

items.q: Can I explore without signing up?
items.a: Yes. You can browse insurers and read product information without creating an account or sharing contact details.

items.q: What should I look for in a plan?
items.a: Read the coverage, exclusions, limits, and conditions provided for the product. An advisor can help you discuss any details that need clarification.

items.q: Can I buy insurance on this website?
items.a: This website helps you explore insurance and contact an advisor. Applications and policy arrangements are discussed directly with the advisor.

items.q: How do I contact an advisor?
items.a: Use the phone or WhatsApp options in the contact section when available. You choose whether to place a call or send a message.
